## Workload

During the quarter, grader Hannah Lowe completed 605 reads across 273 hours. This represents an average of 2.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review against the expected session pattern and provides the basis for the accompanying quality assessment.

## Quality

A sample of 52 reads was checked by reviewer Priya Anand. Agreement between the grader and reviewer was 51.9 per cent. The findings were considered alongside the workload information, and the grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
